historical_references.reference:
The name 'Awwalan' is believed to have originated from the Arabic word 'awwal', which means 'the first'. This name was given to the region that is now known as Awfulan or Awwalan in Nigeria because it was the first place in the region to be Islamized.
Time period: 15th-16th century
Context: The spread of Islam in West Africa

Another theory suggests that the name 'Awwalan' comes from the name of a legendary king named 'Awwal'. According to local folklore, King Awwal was a just and wise ruler who converted to Islam and led his people to embrace the new faith. The name of the region was then derived from his name.
Time period: 13th-14th century
Context: The emergence of local Islamic kingdoms in West Africa
